updates.scope: Swiss prefix/current draw; fixed full quarterfinal bracket after Swiss; sequential knockout-stage observations

assumptions.draw: Published slot-advance language operationalized; not claimed as complete official algorithm.
assumptions.series: IID constant single-game probability; no separately fitted draft, side, or adaptation effect.
assumptions.repeat_waiver: If no legal perfect matching exists, simulate unrestricted draw and count the discretionary-rule fallback.
assumptions.uncertainty: Reported standard errors reflect Monte Carlo error conditional on p1, not model/data uncertainty.
assumptions.examples: Random realizations; these are not most-probable brackets or a fixed future schedule.
